description: alpha_{basis-knot} step 2: the three-strand (Rosso-Jones) delta_q decoration, derived pre-archimedean (no pi).  delta_q(T_{m,p}) = q^{(m-1)p} - q^{-(m-1)p} = h*[(m-1)p]_q is the bar-odd (sinh, e_-) part of the trivial/top Wedderburn channel twist q^{(m-1)p}, where (m-1)p is the writhe of the standard positive braid (sigma_1...sigma_{m-1})^p.  This resolves the OPEN T_{3,4} exponent (w=8 -> delta_q=h[8]_q) and DERIVES the previously-asserted T_{3,5} value (w=10 -> h[10]_q).  It is the same rule as the 2-strand delta_q(T_{2,k})=h[k]_q (w=k), now with the writhe exponent w=(m-1)p, and reduces to the sorry-free Lean identity deltaQ_eq_h_qbracket.  Cross-checked against the Jones polynomials of 8_19=T_{3,4} and 10_124=T_{3,5} (leading twist -q^{2p}).  Nothing fitted.

data.finding: The three-strand delta_q decoration is delta_q(T_{m,p}) = h*[(m-1)p]_q (bar-odd part of the trivial-channel twist q^{(m-1)p}; writhe exponent w=(m-1)p).  T_{3,4} -> h[8]_q (was OPEN); T_{3,5} -> h[10]_q (confirms corpus).  Pre-archimedean (no pi); reduces to the sorry-free Lean identity deltaQ_eq_h_qbracket at exponent w.  Next: per-force alpha_K assembly (step 3) and the no-pi correction (step 6).
